data.name: Dungeons & Death
data.detailed_description:
Dungeons & Death is a top-down action rogue lite about fighting your way solo or with friends through a dangerous campaign, one expedition at a time.

Choose the between Warrior, Wizard, Rogue or Monk. Chain light and running attacks, charge heavy blows, block, parry, grapple and launch enemies into the environment. Build your class with randomized level ups and hidden skills besides your own skill tree. Combine skills alone or with other players to uncover powerful combos.

- Play solo or online. Play alone or with up to four heroes through Steam lobbies and friend invites.

- Four classes with different combat identities. Defend, cast, ambush or fight hand-to-hand with class skills and upgrade paths.

- Action through combat. Block, parry, charge, grapple and launch enemies, then learn the status reactions and combos that tie the party together.

- Overcharging-System: Overcharge skills and pay the overcharging price with your health for ultimate attacks and infinite scaling.

- Quick, standard or long expeditions. Choose the size of the run before setting out; no fixed minute count is promised.

- Routes that can surprise you. Face changing objectives, events, elite affixes and hidden paths.

- An optional human Director. A player can take the seat of the director who uses a command palette and skill tree and limited resources to pressure the party, possess enemies and become spawn your own Dark Hero the Black Knight.

data.short_description: Fight through dark-fantasy expeditions alone or in online co-op with up to four heroes. Choose a quick run or a long one, uncover hidden paths, build a unique hero through randomized upgrades and item drops, and earn your way to the Black Knight in The Final Oath or become the enemy as the Director.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 or Direct3D 11 compatible integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 4-core x86_64 processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with OpenGL 4.6 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution released after 2018; Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or newer recommended for support
  • Processor: x86_64 processor with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution released after 2020 or current SteamOS
  • Processor: 4-core x86_64 processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with OpenGL 4.6 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
